title: Own-Funds Floor by Qualifying Income, Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant Down Payment
content:
The own-funds floor of the reserve a borrower keeps in the down payment under a Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant follows the qualifying income on the loan file — the file's qualifying annual income as a whole-number percent of area median income, as recorded on the borrower's Mortgage Loan File.

**Clause.** Qualifying income at or below 50 percent of area median income sets the floor at 500.00, qualifying income above 80 percent of area median income sets the floor at 2000.00, and qualifying income above 50 and at most 80 percent of area median income keeps the floor at the program's minimum borrower contribution.

| Qualifying income (percent of area median income) | Own-funds floor |
|---|---|
| at or below 50 | 500.00 |
| above 50 and at most 80 | the program's minimum borrower contribution |
| above 80 | 2000.00 |

### Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical incomes)

| Qualifying income | Own-funds floor |
|---|---|
| 50 | 500.00 |
| 51 | the program's minimum borrower contribution |
| 80 | the program's minimum borrower contribution |
| 81 | 2000.00 |

The program's minimum borrower contribution is the Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant's figure in the Closing Cost Credit schedule of borrower commitments.
